image_description: A close-up, angled view of four ring binders standing upright in a row on a shelf. From left to right: a grey binder, a light green binder, a blue binder, and a large red binder. The binders have rigid covers and visible spine labels with text. The bottom portion of the spines features black reinforced sections with white logos or symbols. The lighting is even, casting soft shadows to the right.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white logos/symbols on the black reinforced bottoms appear slightly 'painted on' or smeared rather than being crisp printed or embossed elements. The edges of these white shapes bleed slightly into the black background.

artifact_observations.location: Top edges of the binders where they meet the background
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and minor warping at the very top corners of the binders, lacking the perfect geometric rigidity expected of hard plastic/cardboard. This is subtle but noticeable upon close inspection.

focus_areas: Legibility and glyph structure of text on spine labels
Sharpness and geometric rigidity of binder corners and edges

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the spine labels. AI generators often fail to render coherent text, resulting in 'alien script' or blurred characters. Verify if the text is genuinely readable or just plausible-looking noise. Also, inspect the straightness of the vertical spine edges; AI images sometimes exhibit slight bowing or warping in long straight lines.
